_comment: Single source of truth for the app version. Bump with `pnpm release <patch|minor|major>` (it propagates to package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml). Merging a version CHANGE here to main is what cuts a GitHub release — ordinary merges do nothing. See docs/RELEASING.md.
notes: En Tu Cara — unmissable, fully-local meeting alerts for the macOS menu bar (Apple Silicon). First openable build (valid ad-hoc signature). Installed copies self-update automatically and notify you when they do. Ad-hoc signed for now: on first launch right-click → Open (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway) to get past Gatekeeper until notarization is set up.
